Seminar Title:

Tuning Magnetoelectric Properties in Spin Frustrated and Y- type Hexaferrite Multiferroics

Seminar Type:

Registration Seminar

Department:

Physics and Astronomy

Speaker Name:

Chandan Mahapatra ( Rollno : 524ph1004)

Speaker Type:

Student

Venue:

Seminar Room (PH), Room No. MC 224

Date and Time:

28 Sep 2026 11:00 AM

Contact:

Anil Kumar Singh

Abstract:

Multiferroic materials have attracted considerable research interest due to their unusual coupling between electric and magnetic order parameters, which arises from specific lattice geometries and competing magnetic interactions. However, achieving significant magnetoelectric (ME) coupling is often restricted to low temperatures, making the development and control enhancement of ME coupling near room temperature (RT) a challenge for multifunctional device utilization. Among all the multiferroics, Bi2Fe4O9&nbsp(BFO) and Ba2Mg2Fe12O22&nbsp(BMFO) are selected due to their near and above RT ferroelectric and magnetic transitions. Thin films of BFO and BMFO are deposited using self-prepared sputtering targets in an RF magnetron sputtering system. Further, the deposited films are subjected to high energy Ag and O ion irradiation for introducing controlled defects and modifying the local structural environment. Subsequently, the prepared pellets, pristine films and irradiated films are investigated under rigorous testing to assess their structural, morphological and functional properties for potential applications.
